answer: Each identity plants one walnut tree in an island grove and locks a 70-credit bond maturing after 20 tended epochs; each epoch the keeper files a nectar harvest log; a missed log or a transfer restarts the clock. First costs 36, kth 36+8(k-1), 1000th 8,028; 1,000 fakes pay 4,032,000, locking 70,000 for 20 epochs. Rented groves fail: one log cannot tend two trees. An honest keeper pays 36 once and keeps the harvest.
